source.text_it: Il freno di soccorso interviene in caso di guasto del freno di servizio

records.localized_text: El freno de emergencia actúa en caso de falla del freno de servicio

source.text_it: In caso di eccessiva sovrappressione dell'aria dei serbatoi dell'impianto frenante, il conducente deve astenersi dall'utilizzare i freni e ricorrere maggiormente al rallentatore

records.localized_text: En caso de presión excesiva del aire en los depósitos del sistema de frenos, el conductor debe abstenerse de usar los frenos y recurrir más al retardador

source.text_it: Il conducente che verifica che vi sia un'avaria di uno dei due circuiti dell'impianto frenante, deve arrestarsi quanto prima in condizioni di sicurezza

records.localized_text: El conductor que detecta una avería en uno de los dos circuitos del sistema de frenos debe detenerse lo antes posible en condiciones seguras

source.text_it: L'eccessiva pressione d'aria nei serbatoi dell'impianto frenante è indicata dal manometro presente sul cruscotto

records.localized_text: La presión excesiva de aire en los depósitos del sistema de frenos se indica mediante el manómetro del tablero

source.text_it: In caso di scarsa pressione dell'aria dei serbatoi dell'impianto frenante, è opportuno agire sul pedale del freno per far salire la pressione

records.localized_text: Si la presión de aire de los depósitos de freno es baja, conviene pisar el pedal para aumentarla

source.text_it: In caso di malfunzionamento del distributore duplex è opportuno marciare con il motore ad alto numero di giri

records.localized_text: Si el distribuidor dúplex funciona mal, conviene circular con el motor a altas revoluciones

source.text_it: L'indicazione di un eccesso di pressione dell'aria nei serbatoi dell'impianto frenante può essere causata da un difettoso funzionamento del gruppo di regolazione e controllo

records.localized_text: La indicación de presión excesiva de aire en los depósitos del sistema de frenos puede deberse al funcionamiento defectuoso del grupo de regulación y control

source.text_it: Il limitatore di velocità è obbligatorio per tutti i veicoli delle categorie M2, M3, N2, N3

records.localized_text: El limitador de velocidad es obligatorio para todos los vehículos de las categorías M2, M3, N2 y N3

source.text_it: Il limitatore di velocità è obbligatorio per tutti gli autocarri con massa a pieno carico superiore alle 3,5 t

records.localized_text: El limitador de velocidad es obligatorio para todos los camiones con masa a plena carga superior a 3,5 t

source.text_it: Il limitatore di velocità è obbligatorio per tutti i veicoli cisterna di massa autorizzata maggiore di 12 t, a prescindere dalla loro data di immatricolazione

records.localized_text: El limitador de velocidad es obligatorio para todos los vehículos cisterna de masa autorizada superior a 12 t, independientemente de su fecha de matriculación

source.text_it: Il limitatore di velocità è obbligatorio per tutti i veicoli cisterna immatricolati dopo il 31 dicembre 1987, a prescindere dalla loro massa massima autorizzata

records.localized_text: El limitador de velocidad es obligatorio para todos los vehículos cisterna matriculados después del 31 de diciembre de 1987, independientemente de su masa máxima autorizada

source.text_it: Il limitatore di velocità è obbligatorio per i veicoli delle categorie M2, M3 e consigliato per i veicoli delle categorie N2, N3

records.localized_text: El limitador de velocidad es obligatorio para vehículos de las categorías M2 y M3 y recomendado para los de las categorías N2 y N3

source.text_it: Il cambio di velocità è necessario al fine di ottimizzare l'utilizzo del motore in funzione della velocità del veicolo, della pendenza della strada, della resistenza aerodinamica e del carico

records.localized_text: La caja de cambios es necesaria para optimizar el uso del motor según la velocidad del vehículo, la pendiente de la vía, la resistencia aerodinámica y la carga

source.text_it: Il motore deve essere utilizzato ad un regime (giri/minuto) compreso tra quello di coppia minima e quello di potenza massima in cui si ottengono il migliore rendimento e il minor consumo specifico di carburante

records.localized_text: El motor debe utilizarse a un régimen de revoluciones entre el de par mínimo y el de potencia máxima, donde se obtienen el mejor rendimiento y el menor consumo específico de combustible

source.text_it: Nelle discese ripide bisogna impiegare le marce basse per sfruttare l'effetto frenante del motore

records.localized_text: En las bajadas pronunciadas hay que usar marchas bajas para aprovechar el efecto de frenado del motor

source.text_it: Il cambio di velocità consente di aumentare la forza di trazione alle alte velocità

records.localized_text: La caja de cambios permite aumentar la fuerza de tracción a velocidades altas

source.text_it: Nelle salite percorse con il veicolo carico non si devono mai usare le marce ridotte

records.localized_text: En las subidas recorridas con el vehículo cargado nunca deben usarse marchas reducidas

source.text_it: Nelle salite percorse con il veicolo carico occorre una marcia bassa, che corrisponde una forza di trazione maggiore

records.localized_text: En subidas con el vehículo cargado se necesita una marcha baja, que corresponde a mayor fuerza de tracción

source.text_it: In discesa, l'uso di una marcia bassa consente di sfruttare l'effetto frenante del motore

records.localized_text: En una bajada, usar una marcha baja permite aprovechar el efecto de frenado del motor

source.text_it: In discesa l'uso di una marcia bassa (ridotta) aumenta gli spazi di frenatura

records.localized_text: En una bajada, usar una marcha baja aumenta la distancia de frenado

source.text_it: In ogni condizione di marcia occorre mantenere un numero di giri del motore prossimo a quello di minor consumo specifico

records.localized_text: En cualquier condición de marcha hay que mantener un régimen de revoluciones del motor cercano al de menor consumo específico

source.text_it: Nelle salite percorse con il veicolo carico è opportuno mantenere il motore a un numero di giri compreso nell'intervallo ottimale indicato dal contagiri

records.localized_text: En subidas con el vehículo cargado conviene mantener las revoluciones del motor dentro del intervalo óptimo indicado por el tacómetro

source.text_it: Inserendo una marcia più alta diminuisce il coefficiente di penetrazione aerodinamica (CX)

records.localized_text: Al seleccionar una marcha más alta disminuye el coeficiente de penetración aerodinámica (CX)

source.text_it: Nelle salite percorse con il veicolo carico è opportuno cambiare la marcia quando l'indicatore del contagiri esce dall'intervallo ottimale

records.localized_text: En subidas con el vehículo cargado conviene cambiar de marcha cuando el tacómetro sale del intervalo óptimo

source.text_it: In discesa l'uso di una marcia bassa (ridotta) consente di stabilizzare la velocità del veicolo

records.localized_text: En una bajada, usar una marcha baja permite estabilizar la velocidad del vehículo

rows.text: El freno de socorro permite detener el vehículo si falla el freno de servicio; puede utilizar la parte del sistema que sigue funcionando.
evidence: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/PDF/?uri=OJ%3AL_202600746 — UN Regulation 13, published 2026, §§5.1.2.2 and 5.2.1.2.6: secondary or unaffected service braking can halt a vehicle after service-brake failure, subject to prescribed performance; approval provisions, not a substitute for maintenance.

https://www.icbc.com/assets/en/3ZRN0guL3MkbgvZvTCBfbu/drive_commercial_veh_full.pdf — ICBC Driving Commercial Vehicles, chapter 8, compressor/governor, reservoir safety valve, foot valve, dual circuits and pressure gauges (printed pp.150–155, 166): governor regulates charging, gauge shows reservoir pressure, and a remaining circuit can provide reduced braking after the other fails; a malfunction requires service.

rows.text: El retardador no repara una falla de presión ni sustituye el freno de servicio. Hay que detenerse con seguridad y revisar el sistema.
evidence: https://www.icbc.com/assets/en/3ZRN0guL3MkbgvZvTCBfbu/drive_commercial_veh_full.pdf — ICBC Driving Commercial Vehicles, chapter 8, compressor/governor, reservoir safety valve, foot valve, dual circuits and pressure gauges (printed pp.150–155, 166): governor regulates charging, gauge shows reservoir pressure, and a remaining circuit can provide reduced braking after the other fails; a malfunction requires service.

https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/PDF/?uri=OJ%3AL_202600746 — UN Regulation 13, published 2026, §§5.1.2.2 and 5.2.1.2.6: secondary or unaffected service braking can halt a vehicle after service-brake failure, subject to prescribed performance; approval provisions, not a substitute for maintenance.

rows.text: Un circuito que funciona puede proporcionar frenado residual, pero el sistema está averiado. Hay que detenerse de forma segura cuanto antes y revisarlo.
evidence: https://www.icbc.com/assets/en/3ZRN0guL3MkbgvZvTCBfbu/drive_commercial_veh_full.pdf — ICBC Driving Commercial Vehicles, chapter 8, compressor/governor, reservoir safety valve, foot valve, dual circuits and pressure gauges (printed pp.150–155, 166): governor regulates charging, gauge shows reservoir pressure, and a remaining circuit can provide reduced braking after the other fails; a malfunction requires service.

https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/PDF/?uri=OJ%3AL_202600746 — UN Regulation 13, published 2026, §§5.1.2.2 and 5.2.1.2.6: secondary or unaffected service braking can halt a vehicle after service-brake failure, subject to prescribed performance; approval provisions, not a substitute for maintenance.

rows.text: El manómetro indica la presión en los depósitos. Al comparar la lectura con el rango normal también se puede detectar una presión excesiva.
evidence: https://www.icbc.com/assets/en/3ZRN0guL3MkbgvZvTCBfbu/drive_commercial_veh_full.pdf — ICBC Driving Commercial Vehicles, chapter 8, compressor/governor, reservoir safety valve, foot valve, dual circuits and pressure gauges (printed pp.150–155, 166): governor regulates charging, gauge shows reservoir pressure, and a remaining circuit can provide reduced braking after the other fails; a malfunction requires service.

rows.text: Al pisar el pedal se consume aire, no se llenan los depósitos. El compresor restablece la presión; si no sube, hay que revisar la falla.
evidence: https://www.icbc.com/assets/en/3ZRN0guL3MkbgvZvTCBfbu/drive_commercial_veh_full.pdf — ICBC Driving Commercial Vehicles, chapter 8, compressor/governor, reservoir safety valve, foot valve, dual circuits and pressure gauges (printed pp.150–155, 166): governor regulates charging, gauge shows reservoir pressure, and a remaining circuit can provide reduced braking after the other fails; a malfunction requires service.

rows.text: La válvula dúplex controla el frenado de servicio. Aumentar las revoluciones no la repara: hay que detenerse con seguridad y revisar la falla.
evidence: https://www.icbc.com/assets/en/3ZRN0guL3MkbgvZvTCBfbu/drive_commercial_veh_full.pdf — ICBC Driving Commercial Vehicles, chapter 8, compressor/governor, reservoir safety valve, foot valve, dual circuits and pressure gauges (printed pp.150–155, 166): governor regulates charging, gauge shows reservoir pressure, and a remaining circuit can provide reduced braking after the other fails; a malfunction requires service.

https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/PDF/?uri=OJ%3AL_202600746 — UN Regulation 13, published 2026, §§5.1.2.2 and 5.2.1.2.6: secondary or unaffected service braking can halt a vehicle after service-brake failure, subject to prescribed performance; approval provisions, not a substitute for maintenance.

rows.text: El regulador controla el compresor para mantener la presión dentro de sus límites. Una falla puede impedir que se detenga la carga y causar presión excesiva.
evidence: https://www.icbc.com/assets/en/3ZRN0guL3MkbgvZvTCBfbu/drive_commercial_veh_full.pdf — ICBC Driving Commercial Vehicles, chapter 8, compressor/governor, reservoir safety valve, foot valve, dual circuits and pressure gauges (printed pp.150–155, 166): governor regulates charging, gauge shows reservoir pressure, and a remaining circuit can provide reduced braking after the other fails; a malfunction requires service.

rows.text: El cuestionario marca VERDADERO: el limitador se exige para las categorías pertinentes M2, M3, N2 y N3. La normativa también distingue por fecha de matriculación y prevé exclusiones concretas; «todos» no elimina esas condiciones.
evidence: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX:01992L0006-20021204 — Directive 92/6/EEC as consolidated on 4 December 2002, Articles 1–4 and 6: M2/M3 and N2/N3 rules, registration and emissions phase-in and stated exclusions. Directly inspected exact 5-page local PDF SHA-256 90f8516d7352a0ccfd7e0cfb78185f407c06cf9f6b5555b7d3a41f16cacf8ea0, pp.3–4; historical EU text, not a claim of unchanged current national implementation.

https://rivistagiuridica.aci.it/fileadmin/Documenti/1083_03.pdf — 2005 Italian ministry circular, §2: identifies the relevant categories and different vehicle-registration/emissions requirements, with construction-speed exception; historical context, not a claim that temporary exceptions remain current.

rows.text: El cuestionario marca VERDADERO: los camiones de más de 3,5 toneladas corresponden a N2 o N3, categorías sujetas a las normas del limitador. También importan las fechas de matriculación y las exclusiones previstas, por lo que la masa por sí sola no basta.
evidence: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX:01992L0006-20021204 — Directive 92/6/EEC as consolidated on 4 December 2002, Articles 1–4 and 6: M2/M3 and N2/N3 rules, registration and emissions phase-in and stated exclusions. Directly inspected exact 5-page local PDF SHA-256 90f8516d7352a0ccfd7e0cfb78185f407c06cf9f6b5555b7d3a41f16cacf8ea0, pp.3–4; historical EU text, not a claim of unchanged current national implementation.

https://rivistagiuridica.aci.it/fileadmin/Documenti/1083_03.pdf — 2005 Italian ministry circular, §2: identifies the relevant categories and different vehicle-registration/emissions requirements, with construction-speed exception; historical context, not a claim that temporary exceptions remain current.

rows.text: En estos vehículos no basta la masa: las normas del limitador también establecen fechas de matriculación y condiciones de aplicación.
evidence: https://rivistagiuridica.aci.it/fileadmin/Documenti/1083_03.pdf — Italian ministry circular 2005, §2: registration dates, emissions approvals, category and construction-speed exception for speed-limiter installation; historical application.

https://gazzettaufficiale.biz/atti/2005/20050050/05A01775.htm — 19 November 2004 Italian transposition decree, Art.1 amending Articles 1–4 of the 1994 decree: categories, speed settings and registration-date rules.

rows.text: La fecha por sí sola no basta: la obligación también depende de la categoría y la masa del vehículo y de las demás condiciones aplicables.
evidence: https://rivistagiuridica.aci.it/fileadmin/Documenti/1083_03.pdf — Italian ministry circular 2005, §2: registration dates, emissions approvals, category and construction-speed exception for speed-limiter installation; historical application.

https://gazzettaufficiale.biz/atti/2005/20050050/05A01775.htm — 19 November 2004 Italian transposition decree, Art.1 amending Articles 1–4 of the 1994 decree: categories, speed settings and registration-date rules.

rows.text: El limitador también es obligatorio para las categorías N2 y N3 bajo las condiciones aplicables; no es solo recomendable.
evidence: https://rivistagiuridica.aci.it/fileadmin/Documenti/1083_03.pdf — Italian ministry circular 2005, §2: registration dates, emissions approvals, category and construction-speed exception for speed-limiter installation; historical application.

https://gazzettaufficiale.biz/atti/2005/20050050/05A01775.htm — 19 November 2004 Italian transposition decree, Art.1 amending Articles 1–4 of the 1994 decree: categories, speed settings and registration-date rules.

rows.text: Las relaciones de la caja adaptan el régimen del motor y la fuerza en las ruedas a la velocidad y a la resistencia que se debe vencer, que cambia con la pendiente, la carga y el aire.
evidence: https://www.volvotrucks.com/en-en/news-stories/stories/2016/apr/crawler-gears.html — Volvo Trucks: low crawler gearing improves starting a heavily laden truck on an incline; gear reduction increases available driveline torque in this example.

https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/377668/national-standard-for-driving-lorries.pdf — DVSA National standard for driving lorries, element 2.2.3: gear selection should match speed, gradients, load and conditions.

rows.text: La referencia no es el par mínimo. Para ahorrar combustible se elige la marcha que mantiene el motor en su rango eficiente indicado.
evidence: https://movingon.blog.gov.uk/2019/09/17/6-tips-to-improve-your-vehicles-fuel-efficiency/, DVSA: operating in tachometer green band saves fuel; select right gear downhill.

https://www.volvotrucks.com/en-en/news-stories/stories/2016/apr/crawler-gears.html — Volvo Trucks: low crawler gearing improves starting a heavily laden truck on an incline; gear reduction increases available driveline torque in this example.

https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/377668/national-standard-for-driving-lorries.pdf — DVSA National standard for driving lorries, element 2.2.3: gear selection should match speed, gradients, load and conditions.

rows.text: Una marcha baja aumenta el freno motor y ayuda a controlar la velocidad sin depender continuamente de los frenos de servicio.
evidence: https://en.powys.gov.uk/article/4711/Winter-driving-advice?ccp=true, Powys County Council: use a low gear downhill to avoid excess braking.

https://www.volvotrucks.com/en-en/news-stories/stories/2016/apr/crawler-gears.html — Volvo Trucks: low crawler gearing improves starting a heavily laden truck on an incline; gear reduction increases available driveline torque in this example.

https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/377668/national-standard-for-driving-lorries.pdf — DVSA National standard for driving lorries, element 2.2.3: gear selection should match speed, gradients, load and conditions.

rows.text: Con la misma torsión del motor, una marcha baja multiplica más la torsión en las ruedas que una marcha alta y proporciona mayor fuerza de tracción.
evidence: https://www.volvotrucks.com/en-en/news-stories/stories/2016/apr/crawler-gears.html — Volvo Trucks: low crawler gearing improves starting a heavily laden truck on an incline; gear reduction increases available driveline torque in this example.

https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/377668/national-standard-for-driving-lorries.pdf — DVSA National standard for driving lorries, element 2.2.3: gear selection should match speed, gradients, load and conditions.

rows.text: En una subida, especialmente con carga, puede hacer falta una marcha baja: la relación mayor ayuda a obtener más fuerza en las ruedas.
evidence: https://www.volvotrucks.com/en-en/news-stories/stories/2016/apr/crawler-gears.html — Volvo Trucks: low crawler gearing improves starting a heavily laden truck on an incline; gear reduction increases available driveline torque in this example.

https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/377668/national-standard-for-driving-lorries.pdf — DVSA National standard for driving lorries, element 2.2.3: gear selection should match speed, gradients, load and conditions.

rows.text: Una marcha baja multiplica más el par en las ruedas y aporta más fuerza para vencer la resistencia de la subida con carga.
evidence: https://www.volvotrucks.com/en-en/news-stories/stories/2016/apr/crawler-gears.html — Volvo Trucks: low crawler gearing improves starting a heavily laden truck on an incline; gear reduction increases available driveline torque in this example.

https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/377668/national-standard-for-driving-lorries.pdf — DVSA National standard for driving lorries, element 2.2.3: gear selection should match speed, gradients, load and conditions.

rows.text: En una marcha baja las ruedas hacen girar el motor a mayor régimen; su resistencia ayuda a frenar el vehículo en la bajada.
evidence: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/377668/national-standard-for-driving-lorries.pdf, DVSA National standard for driving lorries, element 2.2.3: choose appropriate gear for speed and conditions, especially gradients and load.
https://en.powys.gov.uk/article/4711/Winter-driving-advice?ccp=true, Powys County Council: use a low gear downhill to avoid excess braking.

rows.text: Una marcha baja favorece el freno motor y ayuda a contener la velocidad en bajada; por sí sola no aumenta la distancia de frenado.
evidence: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/377668/national-standard-for-driving-lorries.pdf, DVSA National standard for driving lorries, element 2.2.3: choose appropriate gear for speed and conditions, especially gradients and load.
https://en.powys.gov.uk/article/4711/Winter-driving-advice?ccp=true, Powys County Council: use a low gear downhill to avoid excess braking.

rows.text: Para conducir de forma económica se busca el rango eficiente del motor, eligiendo una marcha adecuada a las condiciones sin comprometer el control.
evidence: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/377668/national-standard-for-driving-lorries.pdf, DVSA National standard for driving lorries, element 2.2.3: choose appropriate gear for speed and conditions, especially gradients and load.
https://movingon.blog.gov.uk/2019/09/17/6-tips-to-improve-your-vehicles-fuel-efficiency/, DVSA: operating in tachometer green band saves fuel; select right gear downhill.

rows.text: El rango óptimo indicado en el tacómetro ayuda a elegir una marcha que mantenga el motor eficiente durante el esfuerzo de la subida.
evidence: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/377668/national-standard-for-driving-lorries.pdf, DVSA National standard for driving lorries, element 2.2.3: choose appropriate gear for speed and conditions, especially gradients and load.
https://movingon.blog.gov.uk/2019/09/17/6-tips-to-improve-your-vehicles-fuel-efficiency/, DVSA: operating in tachometer green band saves fuel; select right gear downhill.

rows.text: La relación de la caja cambia el régimen del motor, no la forma aerodinámica del vehículo. El coeficiente CX no disminuye simplemente al poner una marcha más alta.
evidence: https://www1.grc.nasa.gov/beginners-guide-to-aeronautics/drag-coefficient/, NASA Glenn: drag coefficient characterizes shape, inclination and flow conditions; gear selection is not itself a change of shape.

rows.text: Si el régimen sale del rango óptimo, cambiar de marcha ayuda a llevarlo de nuevo a la zona útil y mantener la tracción necesaria en subida.
evidence: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/377668/national-standard-for-driving-lorries.pdf, DVSA National standard for driving lorries, element 2.2.3: choose appropriate gear for speed and conditions, especially gradients and load.
https://movingon.blog.gov.uk/2019/09/17/6-tips-to-improve-your-vehicles-fuel-efficiency/, DVSA: operating in tachometer green band saves fuel; select right gear downhill.

rows.text: En bajada, una marcha baja aprovecha la resistencia del motor para ayudar a contener y estabilizar la velocidad; los frenos siguen disponibles cuando se necesiten.
evidence: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/attachment_data/file/377668/national-standard-for-driving-lorries.pdf, DVSA National standard for driving lorries, element 2.2.3: choose appropriate gear for speed and conditions, especially gradients and load.
https://en.powys.gov.uk/article/4711/Winter-driving-advice?ccp=true, Powys County Council: use a low gear downhill to avoid excess braking.
